content_data.meeting_title: UX/UI Brainstorm for 'Nebula Nexus' Onboarding Flow
agenda_items: Review current onboarding user journey and pain points
Identify technical constraints and opportunities for creative solutions
key_decisions: Implement a dynamic background that evolves with user progress.
Integrate subtle sound design cues to enhance engagement.
action_items: Research successful onboarding patterns in competitor games, focusing on engagement metrics (PM: Anya Sharma)
Develop initial concept art for the 'celestial explorer' visual theme (Designer: Kai Chen)
Draft micro-interaction specifications for the first three onboarding steps (Designer: Kai Chen)
Schedule a follow-up meeting with the engineering team to discuss technical feasibility of dynamic elements (PM: Anya Sharma)
